conditional_applicability.profile: Official 7z schema and 7z reader/writer at ip7z/7zip d3296e39e1f1f92c7b41c0c3848e65640428d42d; installed py7zr1.1.0 writer observation is separate corroboration.
conditional_applicability.basis: 7zFormat property ID enumeration and FilesInfo describe streams, empty/anti members, names, times and attributes; no hardlink target/inode field. 7z GetProperty handles path/size/attributes/times and related stream data without hardlink identity; writer obtains ordinary item metadata without a native hardlink target property.
conditional_applicability.resolved_condition: A native-hardlink-input subcase requiring a documented target-bearing record is not instantiated by this profile. This is a positive scoped schema/implementation finding, not only failure to find a fixture.
conditional_applicability.still_unresolved: Universal impossibility across hypothetical private/future 7z extensions is not claimed. A concrete additional target-bearing profile would need its own primary schema, capable producer and independent parse before applicability/execution could be graded.
conditional_applicability.execution_status: NO_GENUINE_NATIVE_HARDLINK_PRODUCT_EXECUTION_CREDIT; no such test is fabricated from retained regular members. Other A13 containment variants and A14 remain separate.
conditional_applicability.ledger_recommendation_only: Retain history and replace the blanket missing-native7z-hardlink-fixture wording, if Root accepts this review, with this scoped documented-profile condition and evidence. Do not award a product PASS, whole-case completion or automatic ledger N/A.

conditional_applicability.profile: LHa for Unix documented header levels0/1/2 at jca02266/lha16619b066b189ef289bb8b07b37d1c38d550da99; same pinned canonical header.c/lhadd.c reader/writer paths inspected (reader also dispatches level3). Compression methods including lh5/lh6/lh7 are payload codecs, not a hardlink-target semantic.
conditional_applicability.basis: Basic headers and OS-independent filename/directory/comment records plus Unix0x50..0x54 permissions, gid/uid, user/group names and time do not carry inode/link target identity. Canonical source explicitly serializes and splits symlinks as name|target with symlink mode; it does not define a corresponding hardlink identity path. Writer treats non-directory/non-symlink inputs as opened regular payloads and has no st_ino/st_nlink tracking in the inspected paths.
conditional_applicability.resolved_condition: A genuine native hardlink fixture cannot be specified using a target-bearing record of this documented Unix profile. The symlink encoding is real and distinct; it must not be relabeled as a hardlink encoding.
conditional_applicability.still_unresolved: No claim covers every OS-specific, private or future LHA extension, or establishes complete semantics of every level3 variant. A concrete additional profile/producer could reopen only that scoped applicability question.
conditional_applicability.execution_status: NO_GENUINE_LHA_HARDLINK_PRODUCT_EXECUTION_CREDIT; any supported real symlink/traversal and resource-limit paths still require exact actual evidence or justified unchanged reuse.
conditional_applicability.ledger_recommendation_only: Treat the blanket LHA-hardlink-fixture gap as a documented-profile applicability condition with this limited evidence, subject to Root review. Do not change ordinary LZH read/create/edit capability gaps into N/A or grant product/whole-case PASS.
